title: Majority of Americans Expect Democrats to Win Control of House; Public Is Split on Senate
summary_en: Americans overall see the Democrats as having a better chance to win a House majority than take control of the Senate.
title_cn: Majority of Americans Expect Democrats to Win Control of House; Public Is Split on Senate

title: So Far, the 119th Congress Is Among the Least Productive of the Past 40 Years
summary_en: The 119th Congress has enacted 121 laws so far, the second fewest of any Congress in the past four decades.
title_cn: So Far, the 119th Congress Is Among the Least Productive of the Past 40 Years
